name: The St. Regis Cairo
positioning: A 36-story St. Regis designed by Michael Graves on the Nile Corniche in downtown Cairo, with butler service for every guest
best_for: Travelers who want a Nile-side base in downtown Cairo with butler service
Families wanting a kids' club, babysitting and a children's pool

facts.text: The hotel rises 36 stories on the Nile riverfront and was designed by architect Michael Graves.
The hotel's address is 1189 Nile Corniche, Downtown Cairo.
Interiors are styled as an homage to the Egyptian aesthetic and traditional artisanship.
St. Regis Butler Service is offered to all hotel guests.
Tianma is a contemporary Asian restaurant inspired by the mythical winged horse of Chinese legend.
La Zisa serves Sicilian-influenced Italian cuisine with Nile River views.
J&G Steakhouse Cairo has a private dining room for up to 12 guests.
The Astor Library on the fifth floor is a book-lined lounge where guests can relax with a drink.
The Iridium Spa has eight treatment suites plus a vitality pool, ice room, light therapy, sauna and steam room.
The St. Regis Athletic Club gym has Nile views and Technogym equipment.
The Amulet Children's Club offers activities including foosball, PlayStation and crafts.

highlights.text: The Astor Grand Ballroom's statement chandelier holds 252,000 Swarovski crystals.
The St. Regis Bar serves a hibiscus-infused St. Regis Bloody Mary and holds sunset Champagne sabering.
Sirocco serves Egyptian creations and drinks al fresco on a deck overlooking the Nile.
Closet wallpaper in the rooms depicts lilies, lotus flowers, birds and greenery of the Nile banks.
The outdoor pool has a heated jacuzzi and a dedicated children's pool.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service; Cairo International Airport is approximately 24 km away.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy downtown area with urban traffic.
